results.content:
Trump’s slide in the polls in recent weeks could signify good news for Democrats ahead of November’s midterm elections. In the newest Economist/YouGov poll, Democrats hold an 8-point lead over the GOP in a generic congressional ballot. [...] According to the Economist/YouGov poll, 61% of respondents said they believed Trump was using his office for personal gain, and 55% said they believed the president was using the Department of Justice to go after his political enemies.

Trump’s controversial East Wing ballroom in the White House has also remained unpopular with Americans, with 57% saying they oppose it.

## What do polling averages show?
results.title: Trump's approval rating hits yet another record low in latest poll

results.content:
In the latest generic congressional voting poll by Economist/YouGov, 40% said if elections for Congress were being held today, they'd vote for the Democratic candidate compared to 32% that said Republican. A whopping 29% said other, not sure or that they would not vote at all.

In Polymarket betting odds on who will win the 2026 midterms, the odds are now favoring a Democratic Party win in both the Senate and the House.
